name: Ignition Benefits
long_description: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.

launches.title: Ignition: The AI-native Benefits Broker for Modern Companies 🚀
launches.tagline: Don't let the dinosaurs run your benefits. For U.S. employers with 20 to 200 employees. Your benefits. Your data. Your decision.
launches.body:
Hey YC! It's Nick.

There's a version of every founder who says health benefits are handled. I was that founder for five years at Plated as we scaled to over 1,000 employees. Our benefits broker never shopped our plan or showed us our claims data, and we overpaid by over $4M without knowing it. Now I'm building Ignition so other founders don't repeat my mistakes. 

Ignition is for operators signing the second-largest line item in the business without being able to audit a dollar of it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=115270&key=user_uploads/765651/78da6cb4-1537-435e-859e-650ecdbb5326)

## The Problem

Employers fund the health insurance system but see almost none of it:

* Renewals arrive as a number with no explanation - dinosaur brokers claim “it’s a hard market.”
* Carriers price you based on data you're never shown - if you’re 500 employees, you see data. If you’re 50, you don’t.
* Small groups get worse rates without a benchmark to push back - no data = no leverage
* Switching feels risky, so most companies stay put.

## The Solution

With Ignition, we combine the market access and expertise of a traditional broker with an AI-native platform that gives you more transparency and control. We’re brining the enterprise benefits experience to the SMB.

### See your workforce the way the carrier does

Ignition analyzes the health and risk data carriers use to price your plan, so you can see what's actually driving your costs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=115270&key=user_uploads/765651/6f505ce5-4438-461f-9ade-8541298a1086)

### Licensed experts + AI interventions in your corner

Our licensed experts compare plans, take your renewal to market, and guide you through your options. AI surfaces recommended actions and answers questions in context, so nothing sits in a black box.

### AI-native benefits administration

Enrollment, renewals, compliance, and life events run on an AI-native platform, with licensed experts in the loop.

### No cost to you

Ignition is paid by the carrier, not you. We analyze your data, identify opportunities, and let you decide what happens next.

## The Ask

Whether you're hiring your twentieth employee or your two hundredth, there's a version of this decision you're making blind right now.

Don't let the dinosaurs run your benefits. Your benefits. Your data. Your decision.

**Book a free review.** If we can't find a better setup than what you've got, we'll tell you.

Reach out: [nick@ignitionbenefits.com](mailto:info@ignitionbenefits.com) · [ignitionbenefits.com](http://ignitionbenefits.com)
